meta.doctrine: AUTO-PROMOTE policy (20 Jul): every nominated candidate is promoted straight into sources.json by scripts/promote.mjs — NO manual review gate. The SCORING loop is the review: promoted sources enter at a conservative tier as lead-finders (DISPUTED-until-corroborated, never confirmation), earn their place by hit-rate, and are dark-flagged then auto-retired when they go silent. Quality is enforced post-hoc by scoring + the discovery junk filter, not by pre-approval. See agents/SCOUT.md.
